entities.summary: Timo Rautiainen (b. 1963-01-25, Sulkava) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sulkava and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
